## Required

Four fields: trip ID, IOTC observer ID, conducted-set count and observed-set count.

This sheet identifies the trip and links its other reported records.

## Available

The 2020–2025 export contains 70 observer-monitored trips and 700 recorded sets.

All 70 source trip IDs and observer links are present; ROS trip-ID construction remains open.

The 15 distinct observers resolve to ObServe person records with full names; IOTC matching remains open.

Agreed: count distinct FishingSet IDs for the selected trip, restricted to activities with VesselActivity code FO.

All 700 activities are FO (fishing operations), each linked to one set. Counts range from 1 to 32 per trip.

Separate observer dates are absent. Observer-specific locations remain unconfirmed.

## To decide

Observed-set count remains unknown until we confirm whether unobserved sets can be recorded.

Do not copy the conducted count or write zero; handling this unresolved mandatory integer remains open.

Agree observer matching, the ROS trip ID and activity-day calculations.

Leaving optional observer dates empty is preferred but unapproved; locations and lost-day reporting remain open.

The source flag called “monitored” means hook-timer use, not observation by a person.

O-INFO is required as this export's trip root. IOTC reporting and importer requirements still need confirmation.
